header: Median dashboard query time since January
description: Median time until a saved dashboard shows its first data, January to June 2026. The March drop came from rewriting the query layer for columnar storage. Later gains come from index tuning.
data_points:
Jan | 4.8
Feb | 4.5
Mar | 3.1
Apr | 2.6
May | 2.2
Jun | 1.9
